answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a relic bet on surviving 67 epochs of grading, and every horizon settlement recomputes the canyon schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 67 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
